args.root_cause: The StatsCache plugin config (plugins/StatsCache/config.yml) was changed to retain-history: true at about 08:13. The plugin then accumulated history in memory, about 1440 entries and 412 MB. Heap climbed from about 380 MB to 754 of 768 MB.
args.actions: Watched status and saw heap rise from 380 to 754 MB. Read the log and found the StatsCache config reload with retain-history=true. Declared the incident. Set retain-history to false in config.yml. A reload command doesn't exist, so I ran `statscache flush`, which freed 1440 entries (~412 MB). Heap fell to about 322 MB, and `statscache stats` then showed 0 entries. Heap was about 400 MB at the last check and rising slowly, which looks like normal garbage, but I did not observe a GC drop. No restart.
args.residual_risk: I did not confirm that the running plugin picked up the new setting, because there is no reload command. `statscache stats` reports retain-history=false and 0 entries. If someone sets retain-history back to true, the leak will return, because history-size 1000 doesn't cap memory (1440 entries were held). Whoever changed the setting should be identified. Keep watching the heap.
